up: Return a list of all approved drugs (max_phase = 4) whose mechanism of action is classified as a positive modulator. For each drug, include its ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and the following target information: target ChEMBL ID, target preferred name, target organism, and the specific action type describing the positive modulation.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS drug_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS drug_name,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism,
  dm.action_type
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON md.molregno = dm.molregno
JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid
JOIN action_type at ON dm.action_type = at.action_type
WHERE
  md.max_phase = 4
  AND at.parent_type = 'POSITIVE MODULATOR';
